method: Independent feature engineering and candidate search over the saved chart_rows.csv; no app files changed.
label: DP iff a three digit panel has exactly two distinct digits; SP and TP are negatives.

selectionProtocol.holdout: 2026-01-01 through latest available date; retrospective, not prospectively preregistered
selectionProtocol.candidateSelection: 2025 only; thresholds are derived from train values
selectionProtocol.ruleSupport: at least 100 train calls, at least 30 validation calls, at least 20 validation active dates
selectionProtocol.probabilitySupport: at least 30 validation calls and 20 active dates
selectionProtocol.confidence: exact two-sided 95% binomial interval plus weekly block bootstrap interval
selectionProtocol.caveat: Searching correlated rules is not independent replication. The 2026 interval is conditional on the policy selected in 2025.

scenarios.scope: 12 app markets; both Open and Close targets

variantCount.matrixCategoryVocabulary: fixed calendar/app domains or categories observed in training rows only

confidence.independentCallsAssumption: Clopper-Pearson assumes independent calls; weekly block bootstrap groups within-week dependence.
